exposure: Chemotherapy (CHOP-like regimens) during second and third trimesters
Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma during pregnancy
outcome: Maternal clinical course (favorable, no serious complications)
Infant clinical course (favorable, no serious complications)
cohort: A pregnant woman diagnosed with primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma at 15 weeks of pregnancy, presenting with superior vena cava syndrome.
finding: The administration of CHOP-like regimens during the second and third trimesters for primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma appears relatively safe for both the mother and infant.
